verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of data portability: a changelog item for exporting a saved View, and programmatic access to Intercom data through the API and SDK (with paginated list endpoints) and through MCP. A customer could use these to extract some data themselves. Nothing documents a complete, self-serve export of all data in open formats for leaving the product. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export, specified open formats (CSV/JSON) covering conversations, contacts, knowledge, and Fin procedures/configuration, offboarding or portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
